fee_notes: Standard initial franchise fee is $49,500 for a single Initial Territory of up to 40,000 Qualified Households. Territory size may be increased at $1.25 per additional Qualified Household. A $4,950 discount is offered to qualified veterans for the Initial Territory. Multi-territory purchases reduce the per-territory fee (2 territories: $89,500 total; 3: $119,500; 4: $149,000; 5: $178,000). Conversion Franchises pay $1,000–$20,000 depending on the nature, size, and scope of the existing business. All initial franchise fees are non-refundable. During the past fiscal year, standard fees were $49,500 for Initial Territory; maximum paid was $144,343.75 for Initial Territory plus Additional Territories. An additional Start-Up Expenses fee of $35,000 is required (separate from the franchise fee).
raw_excerpt: When you sign your franchise agreement, you must pay us $49,500 as the initial franchise fee for a single geographic territory that includes up to 40,000 Qualified Households... The initial franchise fee for a Conversion Franchise will range from $1,000 to $20,000, depending on the nature, size and scope of your existing business.
